SOURCE_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier of the source in the provider's
registry of sources.

SOURCE_KIND.description: What kind of data the source supplies.

Ephemeris.description: Ephemerides: states over time, from an operator or a precise-orbit service

Observation.description: Observations (ranges, angles, other measurements) that states are estimated from

ORIGINATOR.description:
Agency, operator or catalog that created the source data, as it names
itself. Not a message's CCSDS ORIGINATOR, which names who created the
message.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Identifier of the provider that published the product, as the provider
names itself: the module, node or service that retrieved the source data.

PRODUCER.description:
Identifier of the software that made the product from the source data,
with its version when it has one.

LICENSE_CLASS.description: What the source's terms permit for the product.

Unspecified.description: Not stated. Never a grant: treated as CiteOnly.

Reproducible.description: The records may be republished, with the credit the terms ask.

CiteOnly.description: The records are computed on and cited, never republished.

ShareAlike.description: The records may be republished under the same terms, which every derived record carries.

NonCommercial.description: The records may be republished for non-commercial use only.

LICENSE_ID.description:
Identifier of the terms LICENSE_CLASS was read from: an SPDX license
identifier where one applies, else the identifier of the terms in the
provider's licence register.

LINEAGE.description:
Identifier of the lineage the source's data descends from. Sources that
republish one upstream share its lineage, so their products are not
independent of each other.

NUMBER.description: Minor-planet number; 0 when the body is not numbered.

DESIGNATION.description:
Principal provisional designation (e.g. "1999 RQ36"), or the comet
designation (e.g. "1P"); empty when the source gives none.

NAME.description: IAU name (e.g. "Bennu"); empty when the body is not named.

MCA.description: Mars-crossing asteroid: 1.3 AU < q < 1.666 AU, a < 3.2 AU

IMB.description: Inner main-belt asteroid: a < 2.0 AU, q > 1.666 AU

MBA.description: Main-belt asteroid: 2.0 AU < a < 3.2 AU, q > 1.666 AU

OMB.description: Outer main-belt asteroid: 3.2 AU < a < 4.6 AU

TJN.description: Jupiter trojan: 4.6 AU < a < 5.5 AU, e < 0.3

AST.description: Asteroid on an orbit matching no other class

ETc.description: Encke-type comet: Tisserand parameter with Jupiter > 3, a < a(Jupiter)

JFc.description: Jupiter-family comet: 2 < Tisserand parameter with Jupiter < 3

CTc.description: Chiron-type comet: Tisserand parameter with Jupiter > 3, a > a(Jupiter)

COM.description: Comet on an orbit matching no other class

NEO.description: Near-Earth object: perihelion distance below 1.3 AU.

PHA.description:
Potentially hazardous: Earth MOID at most 0.05 AU and H at most 22. False
when EARTH_MOID is not given.

EARTH_MOID.description: Earth minimum orbit intersection distance, AU.

CENTER_NAME.description: Origin of the orbit (CCSDS CENTER_NAME), "SUN" for a heliocentric orbit.

REF_FRAME.description:
Frame the angles are measured in (CCSDS REF_FRAME), e.g. "ICRF", or
"ECLIPJ2000" for the mean ecliptic and equinox of J2000.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system of EPOCH and PERICENTER_EPOCH (CCSDS TIME_SYSTEM), e.g. "TDB".

EPOCH.description: Epoch of osculation, ISO 8601 in TIME_SYSTEM.

RA_OF_ASC_NODE.description: Right ascension (longitude) of the ascending node, deg.

GM.description:
Gravitational parameter of CENTER_NAME the elements were computed with,
km**3/s**2.

PERICENTER_DISTANCE.description: Pericenter distance (q), km: the orbit size of a comet.

PERICENTER_EPOCH.description: Time of pericenter passage, ISO 8601 in TIME_SYSTEM.

ABSOLUTE_MAGNITUDE.description: Absolute magnitude H (IAU H, G system).

SLOPE_PARAMETER.description: Slope parameter G (IAU H, G system).

CEU.description: Current ephemeris uncertainty (Lowell astorb CEU) at CEU_EPOCH, arcsec.

CEU_RATE.description: Rate of change of CEU, arcsec/day.

ORBIT_ARC.description: Observed arc the orbit was fitted to, days.

OBSERVATION_COUNT.description: Observations the orbit was fitted to.

PROVENANCE.description: Where the record comes from and the terms it travels under.
